I want to recognize the Board and Minister for their leadership and managing PNGFA to where we are, esp. those achievement within short period of time is based on the good governance of the Board and leadership of the Minister.  I want to acknowledge the presence of the Minister Hon. Salio Waipo.  His first time as a portfolio Minister moving into Forestry he has given the leadership and showed new way of  doing things not like previous Ministers they give, which I acknowledge what they did but new minister forced for certain things to happen in Forestry and his idea is that we change things, change the mindset and we change the physical part of it as well as the entire operations when the landowners or resource owners when they come to this office they will see that Forestry is no longer like any other institutions where people start to work and perform so I want to commend our Minister Hon. Salio Waipo.  We want to open this Offices when we have special Board Meeting so you are also present to witness what we have done so far. I want to thank the Chairlady for your leadership in managing the Board, I want to recognize deputy Chair – Mr. Bart Impabonj, our senior Board Members.   This occasion, the opeining of the office has happened when we did our organizational structure in the office, we had Corporate Plan Officially opened by Prime Minister at the APEC house.  PM said to us, when you do change you must also do physical change so you’ll see the full reorganization and structure of the organization therefore I followed and listen to instruction on the time. And he said to us that, I want to see reform in Forestry when we launch our Corporate Plan at the APEC house and we followed those instructions and now you see the changes.  First of all, we had Corporate Plan approved and we had Organization restructure/plan approved by DPM.  That is what it call, in a soft way getting organization done. To change completely we have to physically complete some way we do our work, in re organization, we look at all the directorates in Forestry and one of the biggest directorate that needs the new office is the Field Operations -they control the entire country including the provincial forest managers, and I want to thank the board members for approving.  Secondly when I moved into the office, it was very small office for me, coming from department of PMNEC, it was a small office for me, running the all country and im in a small office at the corner.  One of my colleagues came to me and said to me Mr. Koney Samuel – he walked into my office and said, MD you give Millions out to everyone, you write cheques and I write cheques, what about your office, I have big conference room. I would like to acknowledge sec. dept of planning and finance and Treasuery in supported me providing funds on time to build this office facility for PNG Forest Authority. These hoses are designed to withstand high pressure and challenging operating environments while transmitting hydraulic fluid from the pump to the motor. The tube is typically made of rubber, thermoplastic, or a synthetic material, and is designed to be highly resistant to abrasion and erosion. The tube ensures the hydraulic fluid remains within the hose and does not leak out during operation. Laminar flow: In this type of flow, the fluid particles move in smooth, regular paths or layers in a straight line or a parallel stream. The flow is said to be stable and predictable and has very low energy losses due to friction.  2. Turbulent flow: In turbulent flow, the fluid particles flow in a disorderly, chaotic manner, with constantly varying speed and direction. This type of flow is common in high-speed applications and typically exhibits high energy losses due to friction.  3.
